app.title: Money
app.intro: This is the new version of the app, being built step by step. The current app still works as before.

demo.rowSub: Money you can use right now
demo.rowHelp: This is a sample row. Real screens will show your own accounts here.
demo.leftToSpendHelp: Money you can still spend this month after your bills and savings.
demo.budgetUsed: How much of your monthly plan you used
demo.amountHint: How much it costs each month
demo.remindHint: We'll tell you a day before it's due
demo.emptyText: When you connect your bank, your payments will show up here.

activity.title: Activity
activity.noneText: When you connect your bank or card, your payments show up here.
activity.noMatchText: Try a different search, or clear the filters.
activity.leftOut: Left out of In, Out and Net: {list}
activity.inTip: Money that came in: income and refunds.
activity.outTip: Money that went out: spending and bill payments.
activity.netTip: In minus Out. A negative number means more went out than came in.
activity.stale: Updated from a sync. Please make your last change again.
activity.saveFailed: Your change was not saved. Check your connection and try again.
activity.ruleDone: Rule created. {n} transaction tagged. | Rule created. {n} transactions tagged.
activity.ruleDoneNew: Rule created. It tags new transactions.

r.costText: The difference is the fee plus the exchange-rate cost. It is counted as an expense (Fees & FX costs), so your totals stay right. The transfer itself is not counted as income or spending.
r.noCostText: Both sides match, so it counts as neither income nor spending.
r.dupWhy: the same amount, store and day appears twice
r.gapIntro: Each sync compares the bank’s balance with its transactions. If the balance changed by more than the transactions explain, the difference shows here.
r.gapOut: {amt} left this account and no transaction explains it
r.gapIn: {amt} arrived in this account and no transaction explains it
r.gapTextOut: Your {name} balance dropped by {amt} between {from} and {to}, the times of two syncs. The balance itself is right. What is missing is the transaction, so your spending in reports is too low until you add it. Usual causes: a purchase the bank lists with no amount yet (this clears by itself), a payment the bank has not posted yet, a fee, or older history that was never imported.
r.gapTextIn: Your {name} balance rose by {amt} between {from} and {to}, the times of two syncs. The balance itself is right. What is missing is the transaction, so your income in reports is too low until you add it. Usual causes: a payment the bank has not posted yet, or older history that was never imported.
r.gapRecTip: Saves one expense called “Unrecorded charge” in Fees & FX costs, so your totals match the balance. You can edit it later.
r.gapRevTip: Leaves this difference out of your reports and saves your note. Use it when the difference does not matter.
r.gapNoteQ: Why is this difference fine? Your note is saved in the log.

offer.title: Tag more like this?
offer.text: {n} other transaction looks like “{kw}”. A rule tags it, and future ones too, with {tags}. | {n} other transactions look like “{kw}”. A rule tags them, and future ones too, with {tags}.
offer.none: No other transactions look like “{kw}” yet, but a rule would tag future ones with {tags}.
offer.ruleText: A rule adds {tags} to similar transactions automatically from now on.
offer.alsoTag: Also tag the {n} similar transaction I already have | Also tag the {n} similar transactions I already have
offer.noMatches: No other transactions match yet. The rule will tag future ones.

d.cpText: Payment of your {card} bill from the bank. Not counted as spending, because each purchase is already counted on the card.
d.cpTextAny: Payment of a card bill from the bank. Not counted as spending, because each purchase is already counted on the card.
d.cpCountText: This card bill payment will be counted as spending. The same money may then be counted twice, because each purchase is already counted on the card.
d.counted1Text: You chose to count this as spending.
d.cpUncount: Treat it as a card payment again
d.cpUncountQ: Treat it as a card payment?
d.cpUncountText: It will no longer be counted as spending.
d.xfText: Money moved between your own accounts. Not counted as income or spending.
d.xfNoText: The app will stop treating this as a move between your own accounts. It will count as normal income or spending.
d.ignText: You left this out of all totals. It is still listed.
d.ignOffText: It will be included in your totals and reports again.
d.ignOnText: It stays in the list but is not counted as income or spending.
d.futText: The bank listed this ahead of time, for example a card purchase that will be charged later, an instalment or a standing order. It is not in the totals until that day.
d.dupText: Looks like a duplicate of another transaction.
d.dupDelText: This transaction will be removed from your activity.
d.cpMarkText: It will be treated as paying a card bill, so it is not counted as spending.
d.manual: Entered by hand, so there is nothing more from a bank.
d.old: This one was imported before the app started keeping all of the bank’s details. The extra details appear the next time this date is read again.
d.allBank: View all fields from the bank
d.more: More options in the current app

shell.notYetTitle: This page is not in the new app yet
shell.notYetText: It still works in the current app, with all your data.
shell.openInApp: Open it in the current app

home.loadError: We couldn't load your data. Check that the app is running, then try again.
home.emptyText: Get started: connect a bank or Wise, import a file, or add a transaction. This page fills in as your data arrives.
home.worthSub: Bank, wallet and your own accounts today
home.worthTip: The balances of your bank accounts, wallets and the accounts you track yourself, as the bank last reported them. Credit cards are not included.
home.worthTipMissing: An account with no balance yet counts as 0 until a sync reads it.
home.incomeTip: All money that came in. Transfers between your own accounts are not counted.
home.expensesTip: All spending. Card bill payments and transfers between your own accounts are not counted, because the purchases are already counted.
home.netTip: What you kept this month. A minus means you spent more than came in.
home.cards: Cards · this month vs last month
home.cardTip: What you have bought with this card this month so far, compared with last month.
home.wiseCardTip: What you have paid with your Wise card this month so far, compared with last month. It leaves your Wise balance right away, so nothing is charged later.
home.afterPlanned: After what is put aside and planned
home.startTip: Your balance today ({cash}) plus what you have already spent this month ({spent}).
home.startTipActual: Each bar after this takes off what you really spent.
home.startTipPlanned: Each bar after this takes off the budget (or usual month) of that item.
home.availTip: Money in your accounts right now ({cash}) that is not put aside in jars ({saved}). Bills and budgets still to come are not taken off yet.
home.shortTip: Saved money and planned spending add up to more than your accounts.
home.freeTip: Money in your accounts that is not put aside or planned for anything, so it is free to spend or save. Jars take this money on their own while they have room, so it is often ₪0.
home.jarsTip: Money you have put aside on purpose ({amount}). It stays in your accounts but is not for spending.
home.cushionTip: Your cushion ({amount}). The jars never use it and it is not counted as spendable.
home.otherTip: The smaller places your money goes:
home.unplannedTip: Spending in categories that have no budget and no usual monthly amount yet, so nothing was planned for them ({amount}). It is already out of your balance.

itemTip.budget: Your budget {base}. Spent so far this month {spent}. Left in budget {remain}. This is what remains of this budget, not your total money left.
itemTip.bill: Bills this month {base}. Spent so far {spent}. Left to pay {remain}.
itemTip.typical: Your usual month here is {base}. Spent so far this month {spent}. Left of usual {remain}. This is not your total money left.

home.putAsideTip: Money you marked as not for spending: jars and your safety cushion. It stays in your accounts.
home.spentMonthTip: What you have already spent this month, by budget and category.
home.plannedTip: The full budget (or usual month) of each item, and the bills of this month. An item already over its budget counts what you spent. What a jar already pays is not counted again.
home.fxLoading: Exchange rates have not loaded yet. The server fetches them from the European Central Bank.
home.fxUse: Used to convert your Wise balance.

jars.safeSub: Free money that no bill, budget or jar needs.
jars.tooMuchText: Your jars and cushion add up to more than your accounts hold after upcoming bills. Nothing is taken out of a jar by itself. Jars just stop filling until it fits.
jars.allDone: Every jar has its share for this month.
jars.waiting: {amount} more is due this month, but there is no free money to put in.
jars.waitingKept: {amount} more is due this month, but there is no free money to put in ({kept} is kept untouched).
jars.filling: Jars fill up as free money comes in.
jars.putInTip: What the jars have received this month: {amount}. Money you take out by hand is subtracted. Money spent from a jar is not.
jars.stillTip: What the jars still need to reach their monthly amounts: {amount} this month.
jars.availTip: Money you can put into jars right now. In your accounts {cash}, minus in jars {jars}, minus kept untouched {kept}, minus bills and planned spending {reserve}, leaves {free} free to put in jars.
jars.keepSub: Money the jars never use. Example: ₪5,000 for emergencies.
jars.nothingToFill: Nothing to fill: every jar already has its share, or there is no free money.

stTip.noAuto: No monthly amount. Nothing goes into this jar by itself. Edit the jar to set an amount per month.
stTip.full: Full. Now in the jar: {bal}. It has reached its goal.
stTip.fullBill: Full. Now in the jar: {bal}. It has all it needs. It tops up whenever it drops.
stTip.funded: Funded this month. Put in: {got}. This jar has what it needs for this month.
stTip.partly: Partly funded. Put in: {got}, monthly amount: {share}, still due: {want}. It takes the rest as soon as there is free money.
stTip.needs: Needs money. Put in this month: ₪0, still due: {want}.
stTip.needsSoon: It takes this on the next fill.
stTip.needsNo: There is no free money for it right now.

jars.history: Open the current app for this jar's history.
jars.priorityTip: Jars fill in this order, so jar 1 gets free money first. Pick a place, or use the arrows.
jars.paysForTip: When you spend in one of these categories, the jar goes down by that amount. Example: a ₪120 lamp in a linked category lowers the jar by ₪120.
jars.fullByTip: Full by {when}. Still to save {remain}, {cap} per month (planned), {months} months to go.
jars.fullByTipDue: Full by {when}. Still to save {remain}, {cap} per month (planned), {months} months to go. Deadline {due}.
jars.lateAfter: At this pace it is full in {when}, after your deadline ({due}). Put in {amount} a month to make it.
jars.lateNever: At the free money expected, this jar will not be full by your deadline ({due}).
jars.goalsNote: Jars with a goal amount are listed here. Monthly-saving and bill jars are not goals.
jars.reachedLine: You have saved it all. Mark it as done once you have used it.
jars.dueLine: Deadline {due} · 1 month left · needs {req} a month · you put in {c} | Deadline {due} · {m} months left · needs {req} a month · you put in {c}
jars.dueShort: but the free money expected is not enough
jars.savingLine: No deadline · {c} a month · full in 1 month ({when}), if there is free money each month | No deadline · {c} a month · full in {k} months ({when}), if there is free money each month
jars.savingNever: No deadline · {c} a month · not full within 5 years at the free money expected
jars.noneLine: No deadline and no monthly amount, so nothing is added by itself.
jars.noGoals: No goals yet. A goal is a jar with an amount to reach, for example ₪20,000 for a trip. Press + New goal. A deadline is optional.
jars.paidOut: paid out {amount} in 1 payment | paid out {amount} in {n} payments
jars.emptyText: A jar is money you put aside for something, like a trip or a yearly bill. It stays in your bank, but the app keeps it apart so you don't spend it by accident.
jars.loadError: Your jars could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
jars.saveFailed: Your change was not saved. Check your connection and try again.
jars.stale: Updated from a sync. Please make your last change again.
